# gtme runs

List runs, or print one run's receipt (records/cost per step); a rehearsal is marked (dry) and a run that spent money and sourced nothing reads `done — 0 records, $X spent` (ADR-052, ADR-053)

## Forms

```
gtme runs [RUN_ID|last]
```

## Exit codes

| Code | Means |
|---|---|
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | other error |
| 2 | validation or contract error: the plan, the file, or a value was refused |
| 3 | auth or credential error |
| 4 | rate-limited by a vendor |
| 5 | network error |

## Example

From [The gate ladder](/concepts/gate-ladder):

```sh
gtme runs
```
